@@U04336@@
where I will deck the imperial buffet
with sumptuous vessels of gold and silver.
For you, though, Majesty, there will be goblets
of gleaming Venetian glass
beckoning with delight.
In them the wine grows stronger but never intoxicates.
The goblet’s virtue, of course, it too often invoked;
but Your Majesty's moderation will save you from that.

@@U04338@@
These honors as bestowed are sacred and valid;
and yet, for confirmation, we will put it to paper.
And here I see coming just the man to do that.

@@U04339@@
(Enter the CHANCELLOR-ARCHBISHOP)

@@U04341@@
Once the arch entrusts itself to the
keystone, it is forever secure.
You see here four princes, my Lord Chancellor—
also our Archbishop—
with whom I have just discussed
the governance of my house and court.
Let us now consider the Empire as a whole,
for it is on you five that I now rest
its full weight and authority.
You will outshine all others in landed possessions,
and therefore I enlarge your present territories
from the holdings of those rebels who supported our enemy.
But not only are splendid estates
and domains now yours, yours is also
the right to extend them further by way of
succession, purchase, and exchange,
as opportunity affords.
In addition,
yours in perpetuity is the exercise
of those feudal privileges which accrue to you
translation:
@@U04336@@
我将在那里装饰皇家自助餐
以及华丽的金银器皿。
不过，陛下，将为您准备高脚杯
闪闪发光的威尼斯玻璃
高兴地招手。
在它们里面，酒会变得更烈，但永远不会让人陶醉。
当然，人们经常提到高脚杯的美德。
但陛下的节制将使您免遭这种情况。

@@U04338@@
这些荣誉是神圣而有效的；
然而，为了确认，我们将把它写在纸上。
在这里，我看到了能做到这一点的人。

@@U04339@@
（大主教上）

@@U04341@@
一旦拱门将自己托付给
keystone，它永远安全。
你看这里有四位王子，我的大法官——
还有我们的大主教——
我刚才和谁讨论过
我的房子和法庭的治理。
现在让我们考虑整个帝国，
因为我现在要靠你们五个了
它的全部分量和权威。
你将在土地财产方面胜过所有其他人，
因此我扩大了你们目前的领土
那些支持我们敌人的叛乱分子的财产。
但不仅仅是华丽的庄园
现在域名是你的，你的也是
通过以下方式进一步延长这些期限的权利
继承、购买和交换，
只要有机会。
此外，
锻炼是你永久的
你所享有的那些封建特权
